description: Follows Antoine Lavoisier through quantitative chemistry, the transition from phlogiston to oxygen-based explanations of combustion, water as a compound, and chemical nomenclature. Connects the experimental and publishing work of his collaborators with public administration, tax farming and his execution during the French Revolution.
